duplicates.concept: Capability identifier namespace — two different registries both mint `CAP-` ids

locations.detail: vwh.harness-capabilities/1 — 246 rows id CAP-001..CAP-246, one per harness behaviour

duplicates.should_win: vivim-web-harness :: docs/capabilities/atomic-registry.json (CAP-01..CAP-354) as the declared capability inventory
duplicates.reason: Both registries use the same `CAP-` prefix with different padding (3 digits vs 2) and different semantics, so `CAP-01` and `CAP-001` are trivially confusable and a fuzzy cross-reference will silently join the wrong row. The atomic registry carries spec, acceptance, priority, decision state and source links, so it is the inventory of record; the harness capability CSV is a behaviour-level catalogue that should be namespaced (for example `HARNESS-CAP-001`) or explicitly aliased. Until that happens, any crosswalk keyed on `CAP-` is unsafe.
duplicates.evidence: Both registries enumerated this session; id prefixes and ranges confirmed. The duplication scan already flags heavy cross-claiming inside the atomic registry (vivim-web-harness/docs/library/DUPLICATION-SCAN-2026-10-31.md: 'Source files shared by >1 capability: 44 files').
duplicates.labs_action: Record the namespace difference in every row (source registry + id) so a catalogue key is never ambiguous. Never mint a third `CAP-` namespace.

The live HQ `receipts` table currently holds 0 rows, so nothing would be lost by adding the link, and everything would be lost by merging the formats.

duplicates.labs_action: Two receipt references per row, never one merged receipt type.
